workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison. I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against your list. After careful analysis, **Thursday 14:30-15:00** is the only slot that works for all four partners. Elena is free (her Thursday busy times end at 14:30, next busy at 15:30), and David is free (his Thursday busy times end at 14:30, next busy at 16:00). None of the other slots work for both Elena and David. Please create the booking for Thursday Nov 19, 14:30-15:00 and let me know when done so I can send the confirmation email.

workspace.text:

- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both Elena and David are busy 16:30-17:00.
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David is busy 15:00-16:00 (Partner lunch 15:00-15:30, then busy 15:30-16:00).
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy 10:00-10:30 (Hiring panel).
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David are busy 11:00-12:00.

There is no 30-minute slot next week where all four partners are free. I will report this as infeasible.
